html:
The Bektashi Order is a Sufi order of Islam, founded in Anatolia around the saint Haji Bektash in the 1200s, which moved its world headquarters to Tirana in 1925 after Atatürk banned Sufi orders in Turkey.

Bektashism mixes Shia devotion to Ali with mystical and folk practice, allows wine and lets women pray alongside men. It was tied to the Ottoman janissaries and spread widely among Albanians, many of whom saw it as tolerant and national; several leaders of the Albanian national movement were Bektashis. Hoxha banned it with all religions in 1967. It revived after 1990, and its world centre in Tirana opened a large new temple in 2015.
sum: The Bektashi Order is a Sufi order of Islam, founded in Anatolia around the saint Haji Bektash in the 1200s, which moved its world headquarters to Tirana in 1925 after Atatürk banned Sufi orders in Turkey.
